title: RBI imposes monetary penalty on Sindhudurg District Central Co-operative Bank Ltd., Sindhudurg, Maharashtra
description: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has, by an order dated July 17, 2026, imposed a monetary penalty of ₹13.30 lakh (Rupees Thirteen Lakh Thirty Thousand only) on Sindhudurg District Central Co-operative Bank Ltd., Sindhudurg, Maharashtra (the bank) for contravention of provisions of section 20(1) read with section 56 of the Banking Regulation Act, 1949. This penalty has been imposed in exercise of powers conferred on RBI under the provisions of section 47A(1)(c) read with sections 46(4)(i) an
